text:
sara: Quick idea — pilot a 15m triage for the next 3 weeks focused on backlog + hotfix lane. Keep it tight; owners do deep follow-ups async. Proposed cadence: Mon/Wed/Fri 11:15-11:30 PT. Anyone object?

marta: +1 from me. I think shorter will force focus.

alex: I'm fine with 15m as long as we stick to the agenda. 11:15 is a bit tight with my calendar — 11:30 would be easier for me.

raj: 11:30 works better across EU folks. If we do 11:15, can we set a hard stop and doc follow-ups?

simon: Suggest rotating the triage owner every weekday (A/B/C) so same person doesn't do all the heavy lifting. Also: put top-3 backlog items in the thread before the call.

sara: Agreed on rotation. Plan: owner = week-of owner for Monday, Wednesday owner handles hotfix lane on that day. I'll draft a minute template.

sara: Draft agenda (we can tweak):
```
Agenda (15m)
- 60s: roll call + blockers (owner flags)
- 5m: hotfix lane (incidents/high-priority fixes)
- 5m: backlog top-3 (quick triage & assign)
- 3m: assignments + next actions (who will follow up)
```

marta: Love the template. Can we add a one-line flaky-test/infra flag if noticed?

sara: good call — add "infra/flaky-test flags" as a 30s micro-item after roll call.

alex: I'm happy to take week 2 (Nov 8) if someone else can do week 1.

raj: I'll volunteer week 1. I can also cover hotfix lane first week.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Pager on-call for this week: @ops-oncall (see incident channel).

simon: Quick logistics: can someone update the calendar invite with a 15m slot and include the agenda snippet + link to backlog query? makes async prep easier.

sara: I'll create the invite once we confirm time. Quick reaction poll: reply with :thumbsup: for Mon/Wed/Fri 11:15 PT, :one: for 11:30 PT, :two: for 09:30 PT.

marta: :thumbsup:

alex: :one:

raj: :two:

simon: :thumbsup:

sara: Tally so far: 11:15 (marta, simon), 11:30 (alex), 09:30 (raj). Looks split. If no more replies by EOD I'll set up a quick Doodle and pick the majority.

alex: If majority lands on 11:15 I'm fine to move things around this week.

sara: Thanks — will post calendar + minute template here after EOD. Also adding a short pre-read requirement: owners drop top-3 items in thread 2 hours before meeting. Saves time.

marta: I'll add a pinned query to the channel to surface the backlog top items.

sara: Awesome. Closing ask: volunteers for week 3? (Nov 15)

raj: I can take week 3 if no one else steps up.

simon: I can swap for any week if needed.

sara: Perfect. I'll send the invite if the poll doesn't move us. Thanks all — short experiment, expect to iterate. :rocket:
